181:         T::Future: Send + 'static,

183:         if path.is_empty() {

188:         if path.contains('*') {

192:         let prefix = path;
193: 
194:         if path == "/" {
195:             self.nested_at_root = true;
196:         }

198:         match try_downcast::<Router<B>, _>(svc) {
199:             // if the user is nesting a `Router` we can implement nesting
200:             // by simplying copying all the routes and adding the prefix in
201:             // front
202:             Ok(router) => {
203:                 let Router {
204:                     mut routes,
205:                     node,
206:                     fallback,
207:                     // nesting a router that has something nested at root
208:                     // doesn't mean something is nested at root in _this_ router

210:                     nested_at_root: _,

213:                 if let Fallback::Custom(_) = fallback {

217:                 for (id, nested_path) in &node.route_id_to_path {

221:                     } else if path == "/" {
222:                         (&**nested_path).into()

226:                         format!("{}{}", path, nested_path).into()
227:                     };

229:                         Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router) => self.route(
230:                             &full_path,
231:                             method_router.layer(layer_fn(|s| StripPrefix::new(s, prefix))),
232:                         ),
233:                         Endpoint::Route(route) => {

472:     fn call_fallback(
473:         &self,
474:         req: Request<B>,
475:         err: MatchError,
476:         path: String,
477:     ) -> RouteFuture<B, Infallible> {

480:             Fallback::Custom(inner) => inner.clone(),
